messages:
julia.finance: heads up — ticket BF-842 from Bluewave Health. Payment for INV-2026-045 failed (card decline: insufficient_funds). They have a PO: PO-98765 and requested a prorated credit after downgrading mid-cycle (downgrade effective 2026-03-10). Need VAT handling (UK 20%) and confirmation we can issue a credit note and apply to next invoice.
marcus.support: can you confirm the exact downgrade change (plan names/prices) and which billing cycle we should prorate against? i.e., is their billing anchor the 1st of month?
emily.ops: quick check — billing anchor is 1st of month for BLUEWAVE. Old plan = £600/month, new plan = £400/month. Downgrade effective 2026-03-10, March has 31 days.
emily.ops: running prorate now. formula I used:
```
days_remaining = 31 - 10 = 21
monthly_diff = 600 - 400 = 200
prorated_base_credit = monthly_diff * (days_remaining / 31) = 200 * (21/31)
prorated_base_credit ≈ £135.48
vat = 20% of base = £27.10
total_credit = base + vat ≈ £162.58
``` 
emily.ops: rounding to 2dp, credit note should be for £162.58 (GBP) with VAT line separated. will include note: "Prorated downgrade 2026-03-10 (PO-98765)".
nikhil.billing: thanks. i'll create CN-2026-078 for £162.58 and link to INV-2026-045. since the payment failed we should NOT issue a cash refund — apply the credit to the next invoice (INV-2026-060) and show ledger entries. procedure:
```
create_credit_note --customer=BLUEWAVE --invoice=INV-2026-045 --amount=162.58 --currency=GBP --tax_rate=20 --note="Prorated downgrade Mar10-31, PO-98765"
apply_credit --credit=CN-2026-078 --target_invoice=INV-2026-060
ledger_post --debit=AccountsReceivable --credit=Revenue --amount=135.48 --tax=27.10
```
nikhil.billing: i've created CN-2026-078, ledger id LDG-9931. finance-bot confirmed creation.
finance-bot: Credit note CN-2026-078 created and queued for application to next invoice. (id: CN-2026-078, customer: BLUEWAVE, amount: GBP 162.58, tax: GBP 27.10)
julia.finance: are we set to auto-apply, or should support notify the customer first? Bluewave asked for a formal credit note and a statement showing PO reference before they confirm the next payment method.
marcus.support: i'll message the customer with the CN attached and the ledger statement. asked them to confirm the new card or PO billing instructions. tagging @julia.finance for sign-off on message.
julia.finance: sign-off. please include: invoice numbers, PO-98765, CN-2026-078, and note that credit will be applied to next invoice INV-2026-060. include VAT breakdown.
marcus.support: done, customer replied :eyes: "thanks — accept CN and will update payment method by end of week." closing loop once payment method updated.
nikhil.billing: logged a follow-up ticket BF-842-FU to ensure CN applied when INV-2026-060 is generated. leaving this thread open until applied.
julia.finance: thanks everyone. note for records: mid-cycle downgrades should use (days_remaining / days_in_month) * price_diff, VAT computed on the refunded base. filing an internal KB note with example numbers.
marcus.support: +1 — will attach KB link in the ticket.
